name: Redaktorka R.K.
source:
This story is about the usual humanitarian stuff: literature, editing, and death.

The main character is an editor who has to deal with the mysterious suicide of the famous author Stepan Neliyvoda, correcting hyphens for dashes and dashes for commas. Don't be afraid to look in the dictionary, because in this game you will need it!

[Translated from [url=https://mulliganflowers.itch.io/redaktorka-rk]Itch.io[/url]]
